description:
Outcome: Both components have usable verification and documented full-app startup, from manifest evidence.
Scope: Meaningful Vitest frontend tests; backend test dependencies including TestClient/httpx compatibility; backend server dependency; documented frontend/backend launch commands; LAN serving/proxy configuration and frontend-to-API readiness probe; enable recipe stages when established. Excludes: queue product features.
Acceptance: Clean documented environment collects frontend/backend tests and readiness reaches API through frontend serving path.
Behaviour: Actionable startup failures; trusted LAN deployment without public internet exposure.
Verification: Clean install, component tests, launch and readiness during implementation (not setup). Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: retain Vite/Vitest and FastAPI/pytest.
Commands: backend cd backend && pytest established by testpaths and test source; frontend cd frontend && npm test pending test sources; build cd frontend && npm run build manifest-established. Proposed launches cd backend && python -m uvicorn app.main:app and cd frontend && npm run dev; full-app readiness address must be established before enabling VERIFY.
Setup label: B2.
title: Verification and startup
